desc: Derive a rigorous characterization of reachable configurations and minimum cost via compositions of pivot-attraction maps.
Prove impossibility conditions, accounting for preserved piece order, collisions, and final occupancy requirements.
Develop an \(O(N \log N)\)-time feasibility algorithm for the characterization and minimum.
Validate the algorithm on the samples and adversarial edge cases.
Convert the proven algorithm into Python with fast input/output.
